name: brand.state
description: Everything one brand's screens read, in one answer: posts, ideas, shoots, inbox, kit, share links, comments, connections, the brand's linked Pinterest account (its name only), its linked Instagram account and Facebook Page (name and id), its linked TikTok account (name and picture) and its posts sent to the TikTok inbox, pasted links, the company's events from Mission Events and the moodboard (boards, and posts on the shelf or a board).
sql:
select jsonb_build_object(
  'brand', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(b)),
  'today', brandbase.today(b.id, :now::timestamptz),
  'posts', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(p), coalesce(j.jobs, '[]')) order by p.day, p.time) from brandbase.posts p left join lateral (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) as jobs from brandbase.post_jobs x where x.post_id = p.id) j on true where p.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'ideas', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(i)) order by i.created_at, i.id) from brandbase.ideas i where i.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'shoots', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(s)) || jsonb_build_object('crew', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(c)) order by c.position) from brandbase.crew c where c.shoot_id = s.id), '[]')) order by s.day) from brandbase.shoots s where s.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'inbox', jsonb_build_object(
    'people', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(x)) order by x.position) from brandbase.inbox_people x where x.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
    'messages', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(m)) order by
        case when m.done_at is not null then 2 when m.tone = 'noise' or not textfn.has_word(m.text) then 1 else 0 end,
        case when m.done_at is null and m.tone = 'complaint' and textfn.has_word(m.text) then 0 else 1 end,
        m.received_at desc) from brandbase.inbox_messages m where m.brand_id = b.id), '[]')),
  'kit', (select brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(k)) from brandbase.brand_kits k where k.brand_id = b.id),
  'files', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(f)) order by f.updated_at desc) from brandbase.brand_files f where f.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'versions', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(v)) order by v.n desc) from brandbase.voice_versions v where v.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'shareLinks', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(l))) from brandbase.share_links l where l.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'comments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(c)) order by c.created_at, c.id) from brandbase.comments c where c.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'connections', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(k))) from brandbase.connections k where k.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'pinterest', (select jsonb_build_object('username', a.username) from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = b.id and a.platform = 'pinterest'),
  'instagram', (select jsonb_build_object('name', a.username, 'accountId', a.account_id) from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = b.id and a.platform = 'instagram'),
  'facebook', (select jsonb_build_object('name', a.username, 'accountId', a.account_id) from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = b.id and a.platform = 'facebook'),
  'tiktok', (select jsonb_build_object('name', a.username, 'avatar', a.details ->> 'avatar') from brandbase.accounts a where a.brand_id = b.id and a.platform = 'tiktok'),
  'tiktokSends', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('postId', s.post_id, 'status', s.status, 'reason', s.reason, 'updatedAt', brandbase.iso(s.updated_at)) order by s.post_id) from brandbase.tiktok_sends s where s.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'pasted', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', x.id) || x.reference order by x.created_at desc, x.id desc) from brandbase.pasted_links x where x.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
  'events', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', e.id, 'name', e.name, 'status', e.status,
      'allDay', e.all_day,
      'day', (e.starts_at at time zone case when e.all_day then 'Asia/Singapore' else b.timezone end)::date,
      'lastDay', greatest((e.starts_at at time zone case when e.all_day then 'Asia/Singapore' else b.timezone end)::date,
        case when e.all_day then (coalesce(e.ends_at, e.starts_at) at time zone 'Asia/Singapore')::date
          else ((coalesce(e.ends_at, e.starts_at) at time zone b.timezone) - interval '6 hours')::date end),
      'time', case when e.all_day then null else to_char(e.starts_at at time zone b.timezone, 'HH24:MI') end,
      'roomName', e.room_name, 'guestCount', e.guest_count) order by e.starts_at, e.id)
    from brandbase.events e where e.brand_id = b.id
      and coalesce(e.ends_at, e.starts_at) >= :now::timestamptz - interval '93 days'), '[]'),
  'eventsPulledAt', (select brandbase.iso(f.pulled_at) from brandbase.event_feeds f where f.brand_id = b.id),
  'moodboard', jsonb_build_object(
    'boards', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(d)) order by d.position, d.id) from brandbase.moodboard_boards d where d.brand_id = b.id), '[]'),
    'posts', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(m)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(m.created_at)) order by m.board_id is not null, d.position, m.position, m.id) from brandbase.moodboard_posts m left join brandbase.moodboard_boards d on d.id = m.board_id where m.brand_id = b.id), '[]'))
) as result
from brandbase.brands b where b.id = :brand
